articles.title: SecondFi loses $2.4 million in Cardano wallet exploit
articles.snippet: SecondFi was hit by three separate attacks exploiting a flaw in its wallet generation software. A further 129 million ADA was secured by the team before attackers could reach it.

articles.title: Ex-FCA policy insider explains the ‘great divide’ in the UK’s crypto ambition
articles.snippet: Former FCA policymaker and Hedera Global Policy VP, Isadora Arredondo says there is a gap between the U.K.'s crypto ambitions and how policy is carried out in practice.

articles.title: How memecoin marketing moved from online speculation to real-world risk
articles.snippet: From alcohol dares to head-shaving challenges, memecoin campaigns are turning engagement into exploitation.

articles.title: DeFi TVL drops 39% in 2026 amid market downturn and record hack activity
articles.snippet: DeFi TVL fell 39% in 2026 as a broader market downturn and fallout from major exploits, including the Kelp DAO hack, weighed on the sector.

articles.title: SecondFi traces Cardano wallet exploit to address-level issue
articles.snippet: Cardano wallet SecondFi traced the incident to an address-level issue and secured 129 million ADA after attackers drained funds from 374 addresses.
